 150: class InheritedReadSetAdoption:

 153:     Refused owners are kept until that child exits. No arbitrary recovery or
 154:     real namespace capability can be obtained by toggling a field here.

 171:         try:
 172:             rows = validate_manifest(authenticated_payload, root, case, control_value, manifest_sha256)
 173:             _require(not any(not handle.closed and handle.value in {row[1] for row in rows}
 174:                              for handle in self.primitives.handles), "inherited_handle_already_owned")
 175:             read_set = ReadSet()
 176:             self.read_set = read_set
 177:             self.primitives.read_sets.append(read_set)
 178:             # All partial owners precede inheritance and identity queries. The
 179:             # control endpoint is already separately owned, and cannot overlap.
 180:             for name, value, expected, digest in rows:
 181:                 read_set.members.append(self.primitives._retain(value, "adopted-generated-member"))
 182:             ffi = self.primitives.api.ffi
 183:             for handle in read_set.members:
 184:                 flags = ffi.c_uint32()
 185:                 self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
 186:                 _require(flags.value == 1, "exact_inherited_handle_flag_required")
 187:                 self.primitives.api.checked("SetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), 1, 0)
 188:                 self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
 189:                 _require(flags.value == 0, "inherited_flag_not_cleared")
 190:                 self.inheritance_cleared += 1

 192:                 actual = self.primitives.identity(handle)
